statements.status_notes: Chromium renderer memory-safety issue, fixed upstream in 150.0.7871.115. No stable Electron release yet bundles a Chromium at or above that patch (43.1.0 ships 150.0.7871.47), so releases are held for a stable Electron bump rather than shipping a pre-release runtime. Status under_investigation documents the finding without suppressing it, so the release gate stays red. See .github/vex/README.md, section "Known security hold".
